recommendation.summary: Swap the Wasm guest module (S3): 1 changed guest function(s), host unchanged.
justification: every code change is inside a wasip1 guest package; S3 instantiates the new module (re-running its initializers) while the host keeps the state, and drains the old module by reference count
alternatives: S5 handoff if the host ABI (imports/exports) changed
risks: guest-internal state is not migrated by S3; any change to //go:wasmexport signatures or host imports changes the host ABI
